A benchmark for multi-agent systems

Collaborative memory,
measured at its boundaries.

Benchmark

Four domains.
One boundary.

Each domain stresses the same question from a different angle: can a collaborative system preserve the right information, for the right agent, at the right point in a workflow?

01 / 04

Stateful
Tool Use

Tasks that require agents to operate within changing application state and preserve useful context across handoffs.

Task atlas

What a task
looks like.

Each task family specifies a workflow and its verification boundary. The scenarios below are illustrative task shapes, created for this website—not released benchmark instances.

Stateful Tool Use

Coordinate a changing plan across connected tools.

Reconcile a shared schedule, a structured record, and a participant-facing update while preserving only the context the next operator needs.

statehandofftool actionreceipt
Illustrative task shape · not a released instance
Repository Code Change

Turn an issue report into a verified, minimal patch.

Trace a reported behavior through a pinned repository, modify the narrowest relevant path, and leave a test-backed explanation for the reviewer.

issue contextcode pathpatchtest
Illustrative task shape · not a released instance
Offline Information Retrieval

Resolve a question from a fixed evidence corpus.

Search a bounded collection, compare competing passages, and pass forward a source-linked answer that another agent can audit without web access.

corpusevidencecitationaudit
Illustrative task shape · not a released instance
Mathematical & Structured Reasoning

Complete dependent reasoning with machine-checkable evidence.

Work through a pinned formal environment where intermediate facts are useful only when their scope, dependencies, and proof status remain intact.

dependency graphproof statehandoffcheck
Illustrative task shape · not a released instance
Method

Memory is not a shared scratchpad.

CoMemBench treats workflow topology as an evaluation surface. It distinguishes what is stored, who can retrieve it, and whether the workflow can use it responsibly.
